youtube.title: This Map Is Lying To You #4 🌍 Which Is REALLY Bigger? #shorts
youtube.description:
Flat maps stretch everything near the poles. Watch each country slide to its real size 🌍 Did Poland vs Finland get you?
Comment your score out of 4 👇

Follow for a new quiz every day! 🧠

#map #geography #truesize #whichisbigger #quiz #shorts

Data: CIA World Factbook, total area (Kazakhstan 2,724,900 km²; India 3,287,263; Canada 9,984,670; Australia 7,741,220; Poland 312,685; Finland 338,145; Ukraine 603,550; Sweden 450,295).
Outlines: Natural Earth (public domain). The shapes are moved on the globe and re-projected (Mercator) – no resizing by hand.
Music: original.
youtube.comment: Poland vs Finland – did the map fool you? 🌍 Comment your score /4 👇
